title: DOSC and Association With Neighborhood Opportunity: Phase II
official: Pediatric Day-of-Surgery Cancellations and the Association With Neighborhood Opportunity and Indices of Vulnerability : Phase II
summary: Prospective, qualitative interview study to explore factors associated with pediatric day of surgery cancellations (DOSC) from the prospective of parents with hopes the interviews will reveal additional vulnerabilities not included in COI 2.0 that predispose to DOSC.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Parents/guardians of children \<18 who had a day of surgery cancellation
* Parents/guardians speak English, Spanish, Somali, Nepali or Arabic.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Parents/guardians speak a different language other than above listed.
